text:
Maria CS: Heads-up: EU onboarding cohort (~22 tenants, T-78xx) seeing delayed webhook retries and intermittent 503s since ~09:12 UTC. Onboard syncs stalled, some customers reporting missing docs. Need quick customer-facing status + mitigation. @Alex Eng can you confirm scope? cc @Evelyn PM
Alex Eng: Looking now. I'm seeing a spike of 5xx from the webhook-relay service in eu-west-1 starting 09:11 UTC. Suspect a config push that bumped concurrency. Rolling back that change now. ETA 8–12m to validate. I'll update here.
Deploy Bot: rollback initiated — rollout id r-2026-03-21-17 by alex_eng. nodes: 3 -> 0 (one-at-a-time).
Danielle CS: Maria — can you draft a short status note I can send to affected onboarding contacts? We should: 1) acknowledge impact, 2) state mitigation, 3) offer manual backfill/office hours, 4) flag renewal-sensitive accounts.
Maria CS: Draft below — please edit. Copy for CS outreach:
```
Hi {{FirstName}},
We’re investigating an issue affecting onboarding syncs in the EU region which may cause delays or missing documents during initial setup. Our engineering team is rolling back a configuration change and we expect automated syncs to resume within ~30 minutes.
If you need immediate remediation we can run a manual backfill for your data and schedule a 1:1 onboarding session. We’re prioritizing customers currently in active onboarding.
We apologize for the disruption and will follow up with a detailed timeline and root cause.
— Maria, Redwood Customer Success
```
Alex Eng: Rollback finished on node 1/3 at 09:20 UTC, node 2/3 at 09:23 UTC, node 3/3 at 09:25 UTC. Error rates back near baseline — tail latency improved. No data loss detected. Recommend starting manual backfills for impacted tenants.
Maria CS: Great — Danielle / James please coordinate backfills. Also mark these three tenants as renewal-risk-watch (they're in late-stage onboarding).
James Support: Created ticket PS-4321 to track manual backfills and customer confirmations. I'll reach out to CS with ETA windows.
Evelyn PM: Please include exec note: potential SLA credit for affected tenants if onboarding delays exceed 24 hours. Also add a quick telemetry snapshot for postmortem.
Oliver SE: I can help run targeted replays for the worst-hit tenants; send me the list and their expected sources.
Maria CS: Finalized message below (shortened) and sending to affected contacts now. Will include offer for manual backfill + link to schedule office hours. Also adding follow-up deadline: we'll confirm resolution & RCAs within 48h.
```
Hi {{FirstName}},
We experienced onboarding sync delays in the EU region earlier today (09:11–09:25 UTC) that may have affected your initial data sync. Our team rolled back the recent config change and automated syncs have resumed.
If you’re still missing items, we can run a manual backfill or schedule a short troubleshooting session — please reply and we’ll prioritize you.
We’ll send a follow-up with the root cause and mitigation within 48 hours.
— Maria, Redwood CS (ps: ticket PS-4321)
```
Maria CS: Message published to affected customers at 09:40 UTC. Sending follow-up to execs and scheduling postmortem.
Danielle CS: Noted. I'll update the renewal tracker and flag the three priority tenants.
James Support: Backfill scheduling emails sent to top 10; awaiting confirmations. Will update PS-4321 when complete.
Alex Eng: Leaving a short incident note in incidents channel and creating a postmortem draft. I'll include the config diff and monitoring graphs.
Maria CS: Thanks everyone — good cross-team response. I'll collect customer feedback after backfills and include in the RCA. :thumbsup:
